title: A subject's boundary is a fact of the present state

statements.text: The boundary of a conscious subject is a fact of the physical state at one moment, found from that state itself, not chosen by an analyst or read from statistics over time.

sources.quote: It must either derive that boundary from the present physical state or show that every admissible boundary yields the same attribution.
